No appendix is present. The proximal and distal. margins measure 3.2 and 5.2 cm. in circumference respectively. On. opening there is a well circumscribed, 4.4 x 4.0 cm. rubbery tan. white-red tumor mass within the cecal pouch, 1 cm. distal to the. ileocecal valve. A portion of tumor and a portion of normal are. submitted for tissue procurement as requested. On sectioning, the. tumor has a maximal thickness of 1.1 cm., grossly extending through. the muscularis to within 0.1 cm. of the inked free serosal surface. The ileal mucosa and remaining colonic mucosa is unremarkable. glistening tan pink with irregular folds and the walls average 0.5. cm. in thickness. Multiple soft pale tan to tan pink tissues in. keeping with lymph nodes measuring up to 1.4 cm. in greatest. dimension are recovered from the attached mesocolon and mesentery. Representative sections are submitted in 13 blocks as labeled. RS13. BLOCK SUMMARY: 1 - Proximal and distal margins; 2-4 - tumor full. thickness to inked free radial serosal surface; 5 - tumor to. normal;. 6 - ileum; 7 - ICB; 8 - colon; 9 and 10 - eight whole lymph nodes. per cassette; 11 - six whole lymph nodes; 12 and 13 - one bisected. lymph node per cassette.
